statusText: Conditions stay tradable heading into the 13:30 UTC cash open; the July PPI print (unchanged headline, core +0.2%, both below consensus) has already been digested calmly, VIX sits in the mid-14s, and Tail remains low with no observed persistent one-way structure, while Stress is elevated on the imminent open and unresolved Hormuz backdrop
recommendation: Current action remains EA_ON. Reassess through the 13:30-14:30 UTC cash-open window and again around Applied Materials' after-close earnings (~20:30 UTC); an upgrade to a higher Tail state requires observed persistent one-way structure with failed pullbacks after the open, not the open itself.
headline: Nasdaq futures hold a modest premarket gain into the cash open as a soft July PPI confirms disinflation and VIX eases to the mid-14s, while the Strait of Hormuz standoff keeps oil elevated as an unresolved background risk
body: The Bureau of Labor Statistics' July Producer Price Index, released at 12:30 UTC, was unchanged on a seasonally adjusted basis versus a Dow Jones consensus of +0.2%, with core PPI up 0.2% versus a expected +0.3% -- confirming the softer, disinflationary tone that followed Wednesday's in-line CPI report. Nasdaq-100 futures (NQ) were last quoted around 29,806, roughly 0.3% above today's premarket open near 29,712, inside an intraday range of about 29,668-30,002 -- sitting mid-range rather than pinned to either extreme, which by itself does not indicate a persistent no-retracement trend. QQQ's prior regular-session close (Aug 12) was 723.70, +0.73% on the day. The VIX has eased through the session to roughly the mid-14s (last near 14.68) from an earlier print near 15.3, consistent with volatility compression into the print rather than event-proximity stress. The 10-year Treasury yield was last available near 4.70% and the 2-year near 4.22% (Alpha Vantage's most recent daily print, dated Aug 11, is one to two sessions stale). WTI crude was last available near $84.77/bbl (also dated Aug 11); the Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed by Tehran, with Iran's self-declared Persian Gulf Strait Authority continuing to restrict passage and rhetoric between Washington and Tehran persisting, but there is no confirmed fresh overnight escalatory shock with new market transmission -- this stays an unresolved elevated background risk rather than a discontinuity. Semiconductor and AI-infrastructure names showed mixed premarket signals in available reporting (AMD gained on an Oxford research MOU dated Aug 12), but this run could not independently confirm today's specific premarket chip-sector move. Applied Materials reports fiscal Q3 earnings after today's close (~20:30 UTC), a potential catalyst for tomorrow's session. Alpha Vantage's intraday equity time-series endpoint (QQQ 15-minute bars) returned a premium-tier restriction this run rather than usable data, so live tick-by-tick structure could not be directly verified; the premarket range and level figures above come from current web reporting rather than a fresh intraday pull, and a persistent no-retracement trend can therefore be neither confirmed nor ruled out from direct evidence. Confidence is set lower to reflect this gap. Tail stays low at 16%. Stress is elevated at 47%, reflecting the imminent 13:30 UTC cash open and the unresolved oil/Hormuz backdrop rather than any observed pathological price structure.

forecastDetail.comment: Cash open is imminent (13:30 UTC) after an already-calm July PPI print; live QQQ 15-minute bar data was unavailable this run (Alpha Vantage's intraday endpoint returned a premium-tier restriction), so premarket structure is read from reported NQ levels (~29,668-30,002 range) rather than a fresh tick pull, warranting extra caution on confidence.

First hour of cash trading is the key structural test; Stress rises on positioning risk into the open, not on any observed persistent one-way move. A clean two-way open pulls Tail back toward premarket levels quickly.
Opening-hour follow-through determines whether the soft-PPI tailwind extends or fades; no failed-retracement pattern has been observed yet.
Midday digestion; absent confirmed repeated extension after the open, Stress should retreat as the PPI/cash-open catalyst cluster clears.
Afternoon session normalizes further with no fresh scheduled catalyst until Applied Materials reports after today's close.
